title: When the Signal Breaks
author: Oscar Amberdale
blurb: Rafael Montrose, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
